designationHistory.indexText: The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service established Bald Knob National Wildlife Refuge as a satellite of Cache River National Wildlife Refuge to provide habitat for migratory waterfowl.

authority.citation: Administrative establishment by the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Bald Knob National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

USFWS, Environmental Assessment and Forest Habitat Management Plan Cache River and Bald Knob National Wildlife Refuges (ServCat 152673): "Bald Knob NWR was established as a satellite of Cache River NWR on September 22, 1993"

review.note: Sept. 22, 1993 (Cache River forest habitat management plan EA).

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Bald Knob in White County, Arkansas, was established in 1993 to protect and provide feeding and resting areas for migratory waterfowl.
